summary: Enterprise UI/UX Transformation plan for SyncMind AI featuring a persistent Left Sidebar shell (Overview, Meetings, AI Intelligence, Action Items, Work Transfers, Reports & Analytics, Settings), Top Navigation bar with Cmd+K Global Search & Notification Center, Deep Navy & Indigo/Violet design system keeping the Indian team personas (Ananya Sharma, Rohan Deshmukh, Priya Nair), List + Kanban views with slide-over task drawer, and full preservation of all backend APIs, Guided Demo, and AI Copilot.
